prompt:
Use case: identity-preserving character-frame edit.
Asset: one TodoCrew wireframe pet animation frame, astra-candidate/usagi-smooth-idle-1.png.
Input roles: Image 1, original assets/usagi-smooth-idle-1.png = IDENTITY/STYLE LOCK AND corresponding IDLE-1 POSE/ACTION REFERENCE. Prior accepted continuity frame: none, first frame in group. The older generated checkerboard trials are not references; their palette/line drift was not accepted.
Primary request: redraw one complete character as a new high-resolution raster illustration exactly matching the supplied upright standing pose and measured style master.
Invariants / fixed style master: original usagi-smooth-idle-1.png is the fixed character/style authority for ALL frames. Smooth ordinary NON-PIXEL outline, round minimally articulated silhouette, large round head and face, slender upright ears, tiny fluffy tail, extremely short attached arms and feet without detailed fingers or toes. Pale cream body RGB(250,239,197); inner-ear pink RGB(252,191,193); oval cheek pink RGB(252,192,194), EXACTLY THREE dark cheek dashes per cheek; dark brown-black outline/facial ink RGB(7,1,1). Where required by working costume, yellow outfit is RGB(252,225,123), sampled ONLY from original working-1. Outer dark-core contour width 8–10px at 768×512, thus 16–20px at 1536×1024; facial curves 6–8px at final size, thus 12–16px high-res. Smooth antialiasing; rounded caps/joins, no pointed miter joins. Fills nearly flat with very weak soft modulation (body RGB variation around 1–3 values), no strong directional shading, gradient, texture, highlight or glow. Preserve authority's head width (about 284px final), face-to-body ratio, body width, eye size/spacing (about 88px final between centers), eyebrows, cheek position, mouth scale, ear width/length (about 110–117px final), palette, saturation, contrast, outer/feature line weights. Carefree, empty-headed, cheerfully excited personality; never brave, fierce, determined, athletic or heroic. No long limbs, detached arms, stretched body, extra limbs, extra tail or changed facial anatomy. Other pose inputs control ACTION ONLY and never override this master palette, proportions or line weight. Prior accepted continuity candidate controls geometry of pose only and must never propagate style drift.
Intended change: preserve the identity reference's complete silhouette/posture and neutral carefree expression with open eyes; retain the original tiny closed mouth geometry, relaxed tiny arms on both sides and adjacent tiny feet. Provide full transparent-safe bottom padding rather than clipping the feet. Correct the prior trials' excessive warm/light fill and heavy line drift to the measured master. This is the one targeted style correction for idle-1 under the revised workflow.
Composition: exactly ONE centered complete character, high-resolution landscape 1536×1024 if supported. Full ears, feet, hands, fluffy tail, and any required detached motion marks visible. Generous clear margins; upright character about 850px visible height, head/core centered x=768, bottom of feet around y=940, no edge cropping. Final normalization will preserve aspect ratio at 768×512 and visible upright height 420–430px. Keep core head/torso scale stable within about 3%.
Background: the set's decoded native-alpha capability test already failed and is recorded in astra-candidate/README.md. Use a PLAIN FLAT TEXTURELESS MID-GRAY temporary matte, RGB(128,128,128), across the entire background; one solid uniform gray with no noise, gradients or pattern. This is a documented source for local subject-aware Vision foreground segmentation. Export one PNG. No additional transparency-only redraw is wanted.
Avoid: scenery, patterned or checkerboard backgrounds, environmental shadows, grass, props, text, watermark, cropping, extra anatomy, long limbs, detailed hands, altered face, altered character scale. Do not put any ground shadow below the feet. This user-supplied character derivative is only for local TodoCrew wireframe review, NOT distributable TodoCrew artwork.
